digest_rule: composed_digest as in vectors/bundle/composed, with each member's form in the digest input when the member carries it; see canonical_preimage in each case.

history_signature.evidence-interop/0: Ed25519 by `responder` over the UTF-8 JCS of the envelope members profile, request_digest, subject, derivation, anchor, artifact_digest, verification, responder and issued_at that are present (spec/interop-profile-v0.md section 6.2). A case whose options name no history_signature is verified with no deployment signature profile.

cases.description: Two parties' halves of one deal joined pre_agreed_identifier on the deal id (agree), and each party's standard_history/1 answer tied to its own half by same_key: the half's key_id is the History's responder, and the History's anchor (minute 20, 21) is after the half (minute 10, 11). Both same_key agreements are redundant (one key made both); the deal agreement corroborates on declared custody; the two Histories are related through the three derived agreements.

History A is answered, and validly signed, by a key other than the one that signed half A. same_key derives unjoined (history_key_differs); the declared agree fails (join_state_mismatch), and the two Histories are not related.

History A's anchor is A's log at minute 5, before half A (minute 10). A History as of an anchor before the deal is not about it: same_key derives unjoined (history_anchor_predates_deal) and the declared agree fails.
History A's anchor time equals half A's timestamp (minute 10). Only an anchor earlier than the deal is unjoined: same_key derives agree.
History A carries no anchor_checkpoint, so there is no anchor time: same_key is not derivable (history_anchor_time_unknown). Nothing failed, so the block is withheld.
History A carries History B's anchor checkpoint, whose SHA-256 is not A's signed anchor digest: history_anchor_checkpoint_mismatch fails the block, and with no anchor time same_key is not derivable.

History A's issued_at was changed after the responder signed (its member digest recomputed): the signature does not verify (history_signature_invalid, a failure), and same_key does not derive from an unverified responder.
The staple, verified with no deployment signature profile: each History is signature_unverified (withheld, never failed) and neither same_key join derives.

History A's member names History B's request: the answer's request_digest differs from the member's (member_request_digest_mismatch), which fails the block, and same_key does not read an answer to another request.
The staple with History A declared missing and its answer not carried: the composed digest is the staple's; closure is withheld; same_key with a declared-missing member is not derivable.

Half B carries another deal id, so the halves do not join (declared and derived unjoined). Each History still agrees with its own half, but the two Histories are not related: they are only carried in one block.
Party B refused to give its half and answered its History. same_key against a refusal member derives unjoined; the deal join is one_sided.
A pre_agreed_identifier join names History A: a join naming a History member must be same_key.
A same_key join between the two History members: two Histories are never joined to each other.
A same_key join carrying compare: a History has no root record to compare.
History A also carries a bundle: a History member's body is history, never bundle.

Half A's root record carries party A's key_id but no signature (the composing party wrote the key). Nothing shows that A's key signed the half: same_key is not derivable (half_signature_unverified), and the Histories are not related.

Half A is signed by another key, with party A's key copied into its key_id. The Producer Envelope does not verify under that key_id: same_key is not derivable (half_signature_unverified), never agree.
History A is listed in missing but its answer is still carried: closure fails (missing_member_carries_body), and a member listed in missing is not derivable on same_key.

History A's answer gained an unsigned member after its digest was declared: the digest does not reproduce (closure fails), and a body that did not verify as carried is not read by same_key, though its signature still verifies.

history.x-note: added after the member digest was computed

cases.description: Two different deals; the halves also agree on shared_artifact_digest at /spec_version. Only a pre_agreed_identifier agreement between the halves relates two Histories: none here.

Two different deals, linked by a pre_agreed_identifier join on /spec_version, which every record of that version shares. The Histories are reported related, with the pointer /spec_version: the relation is only as strong as the identifier the pointer selects, and the deal-id join is unjoined.
History A's anchor checkpoint is signed with a timestamp that is not an RFC 3339 instant: history_anchor_checkpoint_invalid fails the block, and there is no anchor time.
History A's anchor checkpoint is signed with an RFC 3339 time carrying a numeric offset, not a UTC instant with Z: history_anchor_checkpoint_invalid, as for any other time form.
History A's anchor checkpoint matches the signed anchor digest but its signature does not verify: history_anchor_checkpoint_invalid fails the block.
Party B's half is an empty-history Bundle: same_key against a member with no records derives unjoined; the deal join is one_sided.

Half A's content is party A's signed record, but its carried capsule_id (and the Bundle's root) is another value. The signature verifies over the recomputed Capsule ID, which is not the record the Bundle names: same_key is not derivable (half_signature_unverified).
Half A carries a response naming party B's request: the block fails (member_response_request_digest_mismatch), and same_key does not read a half that failed as carried.
A same_key join carrying pointer: the key is the one that signed the half, never a value a pointer selects.
A refusal member carrying form history: a History member's outcome is artifact.
